column1: # Peak gem5 RSS per checkpoint, in MB: the largest VmHWM over all
# smart_sweep.sh runs of the task, any configuration or window length.
# smart_sweep.sh updates it while runs go (every 5 minutes and at the end)
# and sizes each launch and memory cap from it; commit it after a sweep so
# every clone gets the measurements. Columns, tab-separated: task, peak MB,
# date set, run that set it ("oom-cap <run>": the run was killed at that
# cap, so the true peak is at least this).
